summary: synthetic aperture radar of the Enhanced Integrated Sensor Suite (RQ-4 Block 20/30)

frequency_hz.note: X-band RQ-4B EISS SAR operating frequency (exact frequency unpublished)

bandwidth_hz.note: Chirp bandwidth consistent with ~0.5 m slant-range resolution c/(2B) (Curlander & McDonough Ch. 2)

power_w.note: Unpublished average SAR transmit power; RQ-4B HALE UAV class estimate

peak_power_w.note: Unpublished peak SAR transmit power (~10% duty cycle class estimate)

peak_gain_dbi.note: Unpublished RQ-4B belly SAR array peak gain

noise_figure_db.note: Typical X-band airborne SAR receiver noise figure

system_loss_db.note: Radome, waveguide, and SAR processing losses (assumed)

finest_resolution_m.note: Assumed finest spotlight SAR resolution class (published ~0.3 m spotlight class)

range_min_m.note: Minimum slant range for side-looking grazing geometry

range_max_m.note: Assumed RQ-4B standoff SAR imaging range (~200 km)

curlander-sar.title: J. C. Curlander & R. N. McDonough, Synthetic Aperture Radar: Systems and Signal Processing (Wiley, 1991)
